headline: Pudumjee Paper Products sells entire stake in MITCON Solar Alliance
hook: Exiting its captive solar power venture
summary: Pudumjee Paper Products Limited has agreed to sell its 12,04,999 equity shares in MITCON Solar Alliance Limited to MITCON Sun Power Limited. The total consideration for the stake sale stands at Rs 2.40 crore, plus applicable taxes and duties. Upon completion of this transaction, Pudumjee Paper Products will no longer hold any shares in the solar special purpose vehicle. For retail investors, this routine asset divestment has a negligible impact on the company's core paper manufacturing operations.
why_it_matters: Routine stake sale with negligible impact on core paper business.
